selection_rule: Review all monthly narrative sections in both heating bulletins; retain explicitly named whole regions and explicit warmer/colder direction. Federal districts, partial regions, maps and climatological numeric tables are not expanded into forecasts.
units: Direction only: +1/-1. Not degrees Celsius, anomaly magnitude or assigned probability.
missing: No explicit claim means unknown, never zero/near-normal.
availability: Next day after linked official release; assumes attachment was available with release. Current PDF snapshots are not historical vintages.
comparison_baselines: Climate normal 1991–2020 and prior-year month are distinct. Do not pool them.
model_status: Coverage/alignment experiment only; no forecast model selection.
